backtest_protocol.execution_model: SEC Item 2.02 metadata uses PIT usable_trade_date. Issuer/peer OHLCV and trailing co-movement are observed through signal-date close; paper entry is next open and exit is ten trading days after signal.

gate2.note: The sleeve uses only same-day and trailing OHLCV fields plus next-open/exit prices available to the replay. It does not ask LLM or production to infer hidden fields.
runtime_fields: SPY OHLCV rows for same-window relative strength

gate3.note: No core filter or live entry rule was added. The target source is additive default-off paper, so core survival is unchanged.

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: candidate_pool / entry: strong SEC Item 2.02 issuer reactions may spill over to peers with a measured pre-event return relationship to the issuer.

2_history_check.exp-20260528-036: Sector/market breadth agreement failed; this uses a specific SEC issuer event plus issuer-peer relationship.
2_history_check.exp-20260529-005: Long-base breadth was a price-pattern pool. This adds a non-OHLCV SEC event source plus a PIT OHLCV relation.
2_history_check.exp-20260529-010: Same-sector peer transfer improved aggregate EV but failed late_strong. This run changes the relation field to trailing OHLCV co-movement rather than retuning event reaction thresholds.

gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Same three docs/backtesting.md windows; positive aggregate EV/PnL; 3/3 EV-improved windows; no PnL-regressed window; >=20 paper trades across all 3 windows; drawdown drift <=0.5pp; survival >=5%; concentration inside guardrails.

hypothesis: SEC 8-K Item 2.02 positive issuer reactions may transfer better to liquid peers whose pre-event daily returns co-moved with the issuer than to all same-sector peers.
interpretation: The return-comovement SEC peer-transfer sleeve did not clear Gate 4. Do not promote it or retry nearby SEC peer-transfer relation thresholds on these frozen windows without forward rows or a stronger relation source such as customer/supplier links or audited industry-level similarity.
next_evidence_needed: Forward rows or a materially stronger peer-relation source such as customer/supplier links, official industry classification, or multi-season event co-movement.

source_definition: SEC filing event has form_base/form_type 8-K and Item 2.02
event row must have pit_safe_flag true and usable_trade_date
issuer reaction is measured at usable_trade_date close versus prior close and SPY
peer must share the issuer sector from the static reference map
peer and issuer must have 60 prior trading-day daily return co-movement >= 0.30
peer must be above prior 50-day moving average
peer must have positive 20-day relative strength versus SPY
peer must have 20-day average dollar volume >= 40 million
top-1 selected paper entry per signal date

prediction.confidence_reason: The prior same-sector SEC peer transfer was positive in aggregate but failed late_strong. A trailing pre-event OHLCV co-movement relation is a materially sharper free peer field.

production_impact.promotion_requirement: A retained result would still require a shared default-off paper adapter and parity tests before any daily report or live/default behavior changes.

production_parity.parity_note: No production code path is changed. Acceptance would still require a shared SEC-event paper adapter exposing the same co-movement field in production before any order-affecting use.

why_not_other_changes: Skipped LLM soft-ranking because replay coverage remains sparse; skipped Companyfacts/VBB/VCP/state-surface scalar retunes because the playbook requires forward rows or materially new fields. This tests a sharper free peer-relation field for the prior SEC peer transfer direction.
